g.text: SD05 — Propagate Game Events and Track Quests (UC08, F08, F11; Observer)
referenced by SD03, SD04, SD07 and SD10–SD12
(n1) notifies every subscribed GameEventListener in subscription order: EventLog, MemoryManager, QuestTracker, then the views (subscribed when they are added to the controller)
(n2) e.g. the potion a FETCH objective asks for was used up
(n3) QUEST event, alignment delta −1 (side quests only)
(n4) QUEST event; alignment delta +2 for a side quest (the player helped its giver), 0 for the main quest; delivered to all listeners the same way
(n5) redraws the map, inventory, quest log and event log panels
